## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #214 at **f1cb0fc3bae3d17b13b3d9718a0d7e336b840f9b**. Exact-head delta verification only, not a new review round: `b1461b876ddf13894d2635d85af46b958c5ea63e..f1cb0fc`, one file, `crates/daemon/src/pointer/worker.rs`, +78/-5. Prior unchanged security dispositions, C33/C34 and accepted S214-L001 carry forward.

**F003 repair verified:** lines 188-208 cache the first rendering unconditionally when notes are configured, including when that rendering has no PA line. A retry restores only the body, preserving the other message fields. The regression at lines 3329-3375 covers staged abort, FYIs arriving, retry with the original rendering, leftover clearance and completed delivery.

Recipient/claim guards remain at lines 300-343; framing, size checks and owned-input submission remain at lines 598-620. No delta changes caller authority or introduces shell construction.

**Static cache-cost check:** lines 196-206 perform bounded BTreeMap lookup/insertion/eviction and body copying at rendering attempts. The entry cap remains 64; no new per-tick cache scan, timer, process launch or unbounded entry growth is introduced. Body-copy cost scales with body length, not constant time. No live performance measurement is claimed.

**C34 follow-up S214-N002: terminal socket-refusal cleanup.** Delivered/failed paths reach cache removal, including `forget_holds` at lines 974-980, but the terminal socket-refusal acknowledgement at lines 431-447 bypasses that cleanup. Therefore, “only in-flight jobs occupy the cache” is not universally established. The 64-entry bound still holds; no normal-use security blocker was established in this delta. Clean up this terminal path as a follow-up, rather than claim complete lifecycle cleanup.

Run [42749050916](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42749050916) checked merge `980fd7e7a9c890af0ca55699d7be9d302a18d259`, whose parents are base `04c9e107b2f73497b4142c361bc1e6e0f5d28401` and this exact head. Rust reports **2,379 passed, 6 skipped**. Successful JUnit artifact `13732882414` explicitly lists `pointer::worker::tests::a_retry_after_a_staged_abort_types_the_first_rendering_even_when_fyis_arrive` as passed.

Read-only source verification and existing CI only. No local builds/tests, commands under review, product mutations, credential reads or live probes.
